scenes.text: So you take it to court.
The judge asks, where's the evidence?
The evidence is inside the dog.
Her lawyer slams down the case file. Prove it. Eat this.
He eats it. No evidence. Case dismissed.
Hold on. A dog that eats the evidence? He can never lose.
A cookie thief. He eats the cookie. Not guilty.
A bank robber. He eats the money. Not guilty.
He becomes the most famous lawyer on Earth.
The judge says, bark once for yes. Twice for no.
Did you eat this kid's homework?
Two barks. Because the page he ate was blank. You never did it.
So the judge gives you a thousand pages of homework.
And the dog is licking his lips. So tomorrow, you tell your teacher.
